title: Unit Event — Burn My Soul — Episode6 What's Inside

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD and Ken burn the candle at both ends figuring out how they'll surpass RAD WEEKEND. Tasked with reigniting fervor in the residents of Vivid Street, Akito tries to burn brighter than ever before, but will it go up in smoke?

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You and me singing together, Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But why...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To get you to let your feelings out all at once, of course!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're talking about singing from my heart like Ken said, right? But just singing together doesn't seem like...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Fine, then let's make it a battle!
That should be more enticing, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're not going to run, are you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know what you're doing, and I'd really rather not take the bait...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Just based on her instinct, Luka seems to know what it is that I'm missing.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, you're on.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yay! Thank you, Akito!
This'll help me a lot since I'm much better at getting things across with song!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You did have to twist his arm quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That's just how I do things!
Oh, would you all mind acting as the judges?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, sure!
I'll be a judge!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Thank you! Then, let's get started!
Who should go first? Me...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, I'm going to hit the ground running!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Luka really is an incredible singer...
She's going strong right out the gates.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This song... I've heard it before somewhere...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Oh, right...
This is the one I sang with Toya and the others when we went camping.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(Why does she seem so happy...?
But her smile's kinda infectious.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, that seems like a nice way to start! Now, Akito, it's your turn!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here I go...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (The way Luka sang just now was really good.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But what was she trying to tell me...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, not bad!
In that case, let's see how you do when we speed things up!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? She sounds totally different now!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes.
But this song's...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Yeah...! It's the one I sang when I confronted those guys from Shepard!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (So much happened that time...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I managed to break through the ceiling I had felt trapped under before. But I wasn't satisfied with just that...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (After that, people started telling me that I reminded them of Taiga or Ken... That gave me a bit of confidence.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(However, Len's right...
She sounds completely different now. Almost like some kind of illusion...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(No, wait... There's more to this...
I feel something welling up inside of me.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (In my chest... What is this...?)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Whew...
Okay, Akito, your turn!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Tell me what you're feeling! Give me everything you have!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What I'm feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes!
You've felt and experienced a lot of different emotions up until now. So, let's throw everything we have at each other!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What I've felt...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (What I...felt just now...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, yes!
That's it, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: MEIKO! Is it just me, or did Akito sound a little different just now...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, just a little bit, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay. Now I see...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? See what?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think Luka's trying to draw out Akito's feelings in order to free them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Free them?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Whenever Akito sings, he gives off this impression of wanting to get better—to “surpass”.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And there's nothing wrong with that.
His unyielding work ethic is the reason why he's been able to grow to this point.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But there may be a myriad of other emotions hiding behind all that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Giving up fun things to focus on improving. Burying any worries or sadness that cropped up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, to some degree you need that self-control to keep moving forward. But Akito's done enough of that already.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now, he needs to take the next step.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He needs to dig deep and rediscover those feelings that have been buried away for so long. He needs to free them and turn them into song.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's what Luka's trying to teach him. She's trying to make him realize.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that Ken's been thinking the same thing while singing with Akito...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, he has a special place in Akito's heart. He can't help but tense up in his presence.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But with Luka...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (This is so strange...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I can feel all these emotions rising to the surface...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Fun, excitement, regret...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
You already have everything you need.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
...!
That's it...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If I can turn these feelings into song, then...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Akito! Stooop!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, Luka, what's wrong...?!
Akito was just about to...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I know what was about to happen...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you need to save that for when you sing against Ken.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right now, Akito, there are a lot of different emotions swirling around inside of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you shouldn't be unleashing them on me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You need to do that to your hero. You need to do that to Ken!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, understood.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it, Luka.
I have a much better idea of what I need to do now thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now, go unleash everything you just felt! Pow!
